[P1] The city council has approved a budget for the repair and replanting of three public parks. The plan includes new paths, benches and drainage work, with most of the money going to the oldest park.

[P2] The vote followed a long debate about parking and about whether to close one entrance during construction. Councillors agreed to keep all entrances open where possible and to publish a monthly progress note.

Council approves park budget after debate

[P1] The city council has approved a budget for the repair and replanting of three public parks. The plan includes new paths, benches and drainage work, with most of the money going to the oldest park.

[P2] The vote followed a long debate about parking and about whether to close one entrance during construction. Councillors agreed to keep all entrances open where possible and to publish a monthly progress note.

[P3] Work is expected to begin in the autumn and to take about a year. Residents can comment on the plans at two public meetings, and the council said it will adjust the schedule to avoid the school holidays.
